tooltip.exaltedDefinition: Ek grah us rashi mein hai jahan woh sabse strong aur best kaam karta hai.
tooltip.debilitatedDefinition: Ek grah us rashi mein hai jahan woh sabse zyada weak rehta hai.
tooltip.ownSignDefinition: Ek grah apni hi rashi mein hai — comfortable aur confident.
tooltip.neutralDefinition: Ek grah ek normal rashi mein hai — na sabse best position mein, na sabse weak.
tooltip.retrogradeDefinition: Ek grah jo Earth se peeche jaata hua dikhta hai — iske themes andar ki taraf mudte hain aur dobara samne aate hain.
tooltip.combustDefinition: Ek grah jo Sun ke bahut paas hai — iska apna effect dab jaata hai aur clearly dikhna mushkil ho jaata hai.
tooltip.nakshatraDefinition: 27 lunar nakshatron mein se ek jinse Moon guzarta hai — yeh rashi se bhi zyada detailed jaankari deta hai.
tooltip.padaDefinition: Ek nakshatra ka chauthai hissa (1 se 4) jo uske meaning ko aur clear karta hai.

periodType.growth: Yeh ek genuinely strong period hai — real opportunities khul rahe hain, safe rehne ke bajaye inhe use karna better rahega.
periodType.consolidation: Yeh period naya shuru karne ke bajaye jo pehle se hai use mazboot karne ka reward deta hai.
periodType.testing: Yeh period normal se zyada demand karta hai — bade steps se zyada patience aur consistency matter karti hai.
periodType.grind: Yeh genuinely ek tough period hai — progress expect se slow hogi, par jo abhi carefully banaya jayega wahi tikega.
periodType.instability: Yeh period real unpredictability laata hai — purane patterns shayad na chalein, isliye fixed plan pe ade rehne ke bajaye flexible rahein.

timeEngine.sadeSatiActive: Shani abhi aapki Moon rashi se transit kar raha hai — Sade Sati ({{phase}}).
timeEngine.jupiterActive: Guru abhi aapki Moon rashi se transit kar raha hai — yeh shastra ke hisaab se favourable time hai.
timeEngine.noMajorTransit: Abhi aapki Moon rashi par Shani ya Guru ka koi bada effect nahi hai — yeh genuinely ek calm period hai, na extra pressure hai na extra opportunity. Steady rehne ka accha time hai.
